facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: A bad thing happened in town. Tom saw the truth. He was very scared. He told the truth.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Something terrible happened at the graveyard one dark night. Injun Joe committed a crime but blamed poor Muff Potter for it. Tom had been hiding in the graveyard and saw everything happen. He told the truth even though he was shaking with fear inside. He knew the real criminal and could save an innocent man. But telling the truth meant making a dangerous enemy.
facts.Word cards: truth = 진실 / innocent = 무고한 / trial = 재판 / stood up = 일어섰다
